timeline.summary: On April 28, 2026, TeamLease disclosed the receipt of an EPFO show cause notice for ₹184.58 Cr alleging fund management contraventions.
On May 6, 2026, TeamLease filed an appeal with the Gujarat High Court against an EPFO order regarding NEEM trainees.
On May 6, 2026, TeamLease disclosed the receipt of a CGST Appellate order upholding a penalty of ₹32.29 Cr, which it plans to challenge in the Karnataka High Court.
On May 12, 2026, TeamLease filed a writ petition in the Karnataka High Court challenging the ₹184.58 Cr EPFO show cause notice.

TeamLease Services Limited scheduled a conference call with investors on Q4 FY26 results for May 20, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST, led by Suparna Mitra, Ashok Reddy, Ramani Dathi, Neeti Sharma, and Balasubramanian A.
On May 20, 2026, TeamLease announced its Q4FY26 results and a proposed share buyback of up to ₹238 crores at ₹1,600 per share.
On May 20, 2026, TeamLease announced its board approval for a share buyback of up to ₹238 Cr at ₹1,600 per share.
On May 20, 2026, TeamLease announced its Q4FY26 earnings call transcript and a proposed share buyback of up to ₹238 Cr at ₹1,600 per share.
Teamlease conducted Q1FY27 earnings call on July 29, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹3,056 Cr (+6% YoY), PAT of ₹34.45 Cr (+38% YoY), and completed ₹238 Cr buyback.
TeamLease received a GST show cause notice of ₹52.76 Cr for FY 2022-23 from the Department of Commercial Taxes, Karnataka.
TeamLease announced that the Gujarat High Court granted ad-interim relief staying EPFO proceedings against TeamLease Skills University.
